title: MVP trial
lead: Two-week trial against the roadmap's MVP exit criteria.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: docs/roadmap.md exit criterion: for two straight weeks the household picks dinners and shop from larder's list, and a non-technical household member uses the home-screen app without help.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. At the end: did it meet the exit criteria? What was annoying? What did a non-technical household member say?
2. Go/no-go for Phase 2, and in which order (receipts first, or notifications first)?

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- private notes in `local/` (not committed); a generic summary in `docs/roadmap.md`
- `docs/roadmap.md`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Run two weeks of real use.
2. Hold a retrospective interview; record it.
3. File fixes as slices; reprioritize Phase 2 with `slicer set`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - The retrospective is recorded; the exit criteria are marked met or not, with reasons.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
